title: goodenia collaris
intro: Goodenia collaris, commonly known as the Green Oval-leaved Goodenia or Collar's Goodenia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Goodeniaceae. It is native to Australia and has been traditionally used in Indigenous Australian medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Goodenia collaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
